description: Create a test state: a named set of facts about one account set's data, such as 'Booked' or 'Message unread'. List every fact the state's tests rely on, each scoped to the account set (only this account set's data, e.g. the patient's thread with the doctor) or account-wide (one account as a whole, e.g. the doctor's unread count, naming that account's role). check is a quick read-only check that an account set is in the state. Reuse a matching state from muggle-remote-test-chaining-catalog-get before creating one. Returns the created state.

check.description: Quick read-only check that an account set is in this state, e.g. 'the thread shows one unread message'; may be empty

facts.description: Every fact the state's tests rely on

roleId.description: Test role ID (UUID) whose account an ACCOUNT fact is about; null for an ACCOUNT_SET fact

scope.description: ACCOUNT_SET: only this account set's data, e.g. the patient's thread with the doctor. ACCOUNT: one account as a whole, e.g. the doctor's unread count

statement.description: What holds, e.g. 'the thread shows one unread message'

name.description: State name, unique per project ignoring case, e.g. 'Message unread'

projectId.description: Project ID (UUID) that owns the test states and roles

name: muggle-remote-test-state-create
